```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IClientAction 'FormatDate' ***/
    var formatDate = eSpace.CreateClientAction("FormatDate");
    formatDate.Description = "FormatDate (synthetic)";
    formatDate.Public = false; // default value
    
    var startNode = formatDate.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    formatDate.Function = true;
    var inputDate = formatDate.CreateInputParameter("InputDate");
    inputDate.DataType = eSpace.DateTimeType;
    var ifNode = formatDate.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IIfNode>().ConnectedBelow(startNode, 2057);
    ifNode.SetCondition("InputDate = NullDate()");
    ifNode.Label = "IsEmpty";
    var endNode = formatDate.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    var endNode2 = formatDate.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    ifNode.TrueTarget = endNode;
    ifNode.FalseTarget = endNode2;
}
```
